protocol.status: bounded CPU development implementation, protocol frozen before first run
families: rotated SPD quadratic with condition numbers 1-100
regularized logistic regression on synthetic fixed-support/query data
comparators: training-tuned two-pair L-BFGS without line search
protocol.oracle: Identical scalar loss interface and fixed-direction geometry for every method. No analytic gradients, Hessians, optimum or holdout loss supplied. Compute gradient estimates inside each method or shared pure decoder.
protocol.metaObjective: Fixed training-support population within one three-generation chain. Separate chain seeds. Fresh holdout each generation; never used for selection.
protocol.stateIdentity: History belongs to an objective ID and target dimension; reject reuse after objective or dimension changes. Fresh downstream tasks always start empty, in every arm.
protocol.budget: Eight loss queries per update, no free line search or acceptance queries. Same 33-candidate training search and maximum unroll budget. Extra arithmetic, actual wall time, bytes, scalar queries and invalid proposals reported. No hidden retry search.
protocol.primary: Final-generation fresh-target loss contrast current-vs-fixed proposer with identical retained-history policy, separate per family; median relative reduction >= 1% and exact one-sided sign p < 0.025 per family across 12 seeds. Tie tolerance 1e-6 relative. Must also beat both tuned comparators to claim practical optimizer advantage.
protocol.secondary: State-retention effect within fixed proposer, interaction with proposer evolution, cold reconstruction parity. No alternate primary chosen afterward.
protocol.publication: Source and aggregate report permitted; generated private receipts remain local. No GPU or production change.

executionDetails.conventionalCalibration: 33 candidates, three self-target generations; Adam11 logarithmic rates1e-4..1 crossed beta1 0/0.5/0.9, beta2 .99; L-BFGS33 logarithmic rates1e-4..1
executionDetails.learnedGeometry: Cholesky2x2 SPD rescaled eigenvalues into[0.1,2], eta exp(-4+clamp(z,-2,2))
executionDetails.accounting: Initialization and both conventional calibrations charged equally to every arm; report actual shared work separately
executionDetails.reconstruction: Exact state/parameter roundtrip each generation; pure deterministic implementation, no process-isolation result claimed
